After import: Test C quiz types

The cartridge carries folders, titles, descriptions, and assignment points. Everything on this page has to be set in Schoology by hand.

Import the cartridge

  1. In Schoology, open Resources.
  2. Choose Import, then Common Cartridge, and pick the .imscc file.
  3. When it finishes, open the imported folder and use Add to Course.
